# Low-level design (LLD)

Low-level design rounds test whether you can turn requirements into clean, extensible, working classes - often while coding live. This section covers the Python and design fundamentals interviewers expect, the patterns worth naming and the machine-coding problems that come up most often, each with a tested package. Start with the LLD interview framework, learn the P0 patterns, then solve the P0 problems against the clock.

## Sections

- [Fundamentals](fundamentals/index.md) - 8 pages: Python, SOLID, UML, concurrency and the LLD framework
- [Design patterns](patterns/index.md) - 32 pages: the patterns worth naming, with tested Python and the classic confusions
- [Problems](problems/index.md) - 36 pages: machine-coding problems with complete tested packages
